source.publication: 2025 Expanded Instructions (IA 1040) and the 2025 IA 1040 Iowa Individual Income Tax Return
source.section: IA 1040 form PDF p.1 Step 3 lines a, b, d; form PDF p.2 lines 1c, 2-5, 7, 8, 11, 12; Instructions PDF p.8 Step 3; PDF p.9-10 lines 2-4; PDF p.12 line 5 ('Iowa now has a flat tax rate of 3.8%'); PDF p.18 line 12

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 16,250.00 = 16,250.00. Federal taxable income = 16,250.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IA 1040 filing status 1 (single). Step 3 line a personal credits 1 x 40.00 = 40.00; line b 0 x 20.00 = 0.00 (65 or older on or before January 1, 2026; nobody blind); line c no dependents; line d and line 8 = 40.00. Line 1c federal AGI 16,250.00; line 2 federal taxable income 500.00. Schedule 1: no additions or subtractions. Schedule 1 line 21 net modifications = 0.00; line 3 = 0.00. Line 4 Iowa taxable income = 500.00 + (0.00) = 500.00. Line 5 tax = 3.8% x 500.00 = 19.00; line 7 = 19.00. Line 11 total credits 40.00; line 12 = 19.00 - 40.00, below zero, so enter 0.00 (non-refundable; expected credits shows the 19.00 used). State income tax 0.00 (no line 13-17 credits; line 19 school district or EMS surtax is local, not computed). The form allows whole-dollar rounding; expected keeps the cents. Low-income exemption test (PDF p.10-11): line 4 500.00 + federal deduction 15,750.00 = 16,250.00, against 9,000.00: not exempt. Single filers' tax reduction (PDF p.18): its worksheet 41-146 is not in the sources, so it is not applied. The tax of 19.00 is under the 40.00 credit, so the credit stops at the tax.
accepted_approximations: The low-income exemption, the alternate tax (every status except single) and the single filers' tax reduction are not applied; the record holds them in notes. The reduction's terms are not in the sources.
School district and county EMS surtaxes (a percentage of the tax, form line 19) are local and out of scope (issue #1).
